title: Noor and the Vector
author: Sebastian Sterling
blurb: Astrid Eastwick, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
